observation: Overall color scheme differs: A uses a white page body with dark grey text, while B uses a near-black page body with warm off-white text.
evidence: A body_bg rgb(255,255,255), body_color rgb(88,88,88); B body_bg rgb(15,14,14), body_color rgb(242,236,228)

observation: Each side uses a different accent hue: A uses a saturated red, B uses a burnt orange.
evidence: A top_backgrounds include rgb(232,43,24) (7 elements) and red 'HOME' nav item; B top_backgrounds include rgb(226,104,43) (5 elements) on announcement bar and buttons

observation: A's typography mixes several webfonts: Open Sans, Cabin, Krona One, a script face (Arizonia) and book antiqua. B uses only system-ui, Georgia and Arial.
evidence: A fonts: Open Sans 302, Cabin 155, Krona One 66, FontAwesome 5, book antiqua 4, Arizonia 1; B fonts: system-ui 88, Georgia 15, Arial 2

observation: A's h1 is set in a bold uppercase sans-serif. B's h1 is a larger serif at normal weight in sentence case.
evidence: A h1: 60px, weight 700, Cabin, 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA'; B h1: 76px, weight 400, Georgia, 'Modern & Contemporary Art'

observation: A has 27 h1 elements: the slider titles are repeated three times. B has a single h1.
evidence: A h1_count 27, with the outline repeating 9 slide titles 3×; B h1_count 1

observation: Section headings in A are small and uppercase. B's are large serif headings in sentence case.
evidence: A h2 20px/700 'PHOTO\nGALLERY'; B h2 44px/400 'Photo gallery'

observation: B adds an h3 'Login or register' heading, which A does not have.
evidence: B heading_outline includes level 3 'Login or register'; B tag_counts h3: 1

observation: Page titles differ: A is titled 'Home', while B uses the full foundation name.
evidence: A title 'Home'; B title 'F N Souza International Fine Arts Foundation & Family Trust Inc.'

observation: The language attributes differ in regional specificity.
evidence: A lang 'en-gb'; B lang 'en'

observation: A's header is a full-width painting slider with a centered, uppercase wide-display logotype and a script 'History & Works' tagline. B's header is a compact dark bar with a small serif wordmark on the left and the nav on the right.
evidence: A_slice_00 top: centered Krona One-style title over the painting; B_slice_00: left-aligned two-line serif name and right-aligned nav in a dark bar

observation: The forgery-exoneration notice is handled differently. A places it as an uppercase nav item that wraps to a second line. B shows it as an underlined link in a separate orange announcement bar at the top.
evidence: A_slice_00 nav row 2: 'F. N. SOUZA EXONERATES SON...'; B_slice_00 orange bar with title-case underlined text

observation: A's nav labels are uppercase, with the active item in red. B's nav labels are title case in muted grey, with dropdown caret indicators.
evidence: A 'HOME' in red, 'ABOUT F N SOUZA'; B 'Family History ▾', 'Available For Sale ▾'

observation: A's hero is a painting slideshow with an overlay title and 9 circular pagination dots. B's hero is a static dark, abstract painterly background with an eyebrow, headline, subtitle and two CTA buttons.
evidence: A_slice_00: 'CIUDAD EN ESAPANA' with 9 dots; B_slice_00: 'HISTORY & WORKS' eyebrow, 'Explore the gallery' / 'About the artist' buttons

observation: B turns the nine slide titles into a horizontal strip of italic serif labels, each with an orange star bullet, placed below the hero.
evidence: B_slice_00 strip: '✦ Ciudad En Esapana ✦ Multicoloured Villagescape ... ✦ Last Supper'

observation: A's hero includes a semi-transparent dark band behind the header and nav.
evidence: A top_backgrounds rgba(1,1,0,0.53); A_slice_00 translucent overlay at the top

observation: B's sticky header uses a translucent background with a backdrop blur.
